_comment: Self-update UNIT RECONCILER manifest (0.9.0). install.sh writes ETK system.d units via heredocs. A couch-only update (Pitstop -> TOOLS -> Check for ETK Updates) copies bin/scripts/config trees but NEVER re-runs install.sh, so a shipped UNIT fix (e.g. the osguard After= ordering fix) would otherwise never reach couch-only users. _self_update_apply reads THIS tag's manifest and patches the named directives on units that ALREADY EXIST on the rig. It does NOT create missing units (install.sh owns first creation) and never invents sections. Each 'set' value MUST stay byte-identical to install.sh's heredoc for that unit, or couch-updated and host-installed rigs diverge -- tools/test_unit_reconcile.py asserts the osguard After= parity against install.sh.

units.name: etk-osguard.service
units.reason: After= must include the units that MOUNT the ETK tree, or the unit's ConditionPathExists is evaluated at bare local-fs.target (before games-internal is mounted) and the guard is silently SKIPPED -- the 2026-08-11 ordering lesson; osguard missed the 2026-08-28 nightly frankenboot for exactly this. Pre-0.9.0 installs shipped a shorter After=; couch updates never re-ran install.sh to fix it.
